works.body:
I would like to request an illustration by Momojiru Hodo.
If it's a "smug smile", I'll leave the details to you.

Nice to meet you.
I have seen your cute and pop SD illustrations of sound game characters, etc!
May I ask you to illustrate a character of my own creation, "Shiina"?
The materials and settings are listed below. Thank you very much for your consideration!

She is a petite girl who is bright, energetic, light-hearted and good-natured. Her height is around 140cm.
She has long hair on the right side and green eye highlights in the center.
She has long, fluffy, azuki brown hair and wears black, red, and brown berets, dresses, etc. She is a big fan of Coke.
She is a big fan of cola and drinks it often.
